description_en: Links knowledge categories to a chatbot
kebab_example: aliyun chatbot link-instance-category --instance-id chatbot-cn-mp90s2lrk00050 --category-ids 30000065789 --agent-key ac627989eb4f8a98ed05fd098bbae5_p_beebot_public --ability-type FAQ,MRC --api-version 2022-04-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: LinkInstanceCategory

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the chatbot
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: An array of FAQ category IDs to link to the chatbot
parameters.help_zh: 绑定到机器人的FAQ类目ID数组
parameters.name: category_ids

parameters.help_en: The key for the business space. If you do not specify this parameter, the default business space is used. You can obtain the key on the Business Management page of your primary account
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间key，不设置则访问默认业务空间，key值在主账号业务管理页面获取
parameters.name: agent_key

parameters.help_en: The category's ability type. Valid values: `FAQ` and `MRC` (machine reading comprehension). Defaults to `FAQ`
parameters.help_zh: 类目的能力类型，如FAQ（高频问答），MRC（文档），默认FAQ
parameters.name: ability_type
